analytics.title: Interactive ML Analysis
analytics.subtitle: Maklada Eljem · 9,488 work orders · 16,503 matched spare part records · 7,031 unlinked records
analytics.machineCost_sub: Real Q1–Q2 2025 + Predicted Q3–Q4 2025 vs Forecast 2026 · Top 5 by historical cost
analytics.machineCost_note_hw: M-620: +62.7% · M-790: +23.5% · M-640: +67.7% · M-770: +104.7% · M-990: -28.8% (only machine decreasing — HW detected seasonal drop)
analytics.parts_title: Parts Consumption Forecast — Top 5 Machines by Quantity
analytics.parts_sub: Predicted parts consumed (pcs) per machine · Q3–Q4 2025 + Full 2026
analytics.parts_mlnote: Machine 790 dominates with 148,933 total parts — mainly bulk consumable CHAUX ETEINTE (slaked lime). Machine 730 shows near-zero forecast due to data gaps.
analytics.total_title: Total Factory Cost Forecast — All Machines Combined
analytics.total_note_hw: Full 2025: 929,851 DT · Full 2026: 1,025,331 DT · Trend: +10.3% · Historical avg/quarter: 225,994 DT
analytics.total_note_lr: Full 2025: 923,808 DT · Full 2026: 966,722 DT · Trend: +4.6% · Slope: +1,046 DT/quarter
analytics.total_mlnote_hw: Holt-Winters detects Q1 is always the cheapest quarter. Q1 2026 predicted +56.6% vs Q1 2025.
analytics.total_mlnote_lr: Linear Regression sees a steady +1,046 DT/quarter slope. Forecasts nearly flat across Q1–Q4 2026 (240k–243k DT).
analytics.anomaly_title: Maintenance Cost Anomaly Detection — Z-Score per Work Order
analytics.anomaly_sub: Z-Score threshold: 2.5σ · Threshold: 8,132 DT · Factory Maklada Eljem · 2020–2025
analytics.anomaly_note: 36 anomalies detected out of 3,049 WOs with parts (1.2%). Worst: BT 99549 — 220,970 DT (2024). 2022 had most anomalies (11). 2025 already 2 anomalies in H1.
analytics.phantom_title: Phantom Parts Audit — Untraced Stock Exits
analytics.phantom_sub: Parts exits with no matching work order · 7,031 records · 2,016,160 DT total
analytics.phantom_note: 2025 (Jan–Jun only): phantom cost 310,549 DT vs normal 141,992 DT — phantom exceeds normal for the first time. Top article: FILTRE ANTI HARMONIQUE ACTIF — 123,814 DT single exit.
analytics.top15Summary: Top 15 = 605,821 DT = 30.0% of all phantom cost · Total phantom exits: 7,031 · First: 02/01/2020 · Last: 02/03/2026
analytics.risk_title: Machine Risk Dashboard — Ranked Table View
analytics.risk_sub: Weighted Scoring Model: Breakdown Frequency (45%) + Cost (35%) + Cost Erraticity (20%) · Top 20
analytics.risk_note: 3 HIGH RISK: M-720 (66.4/100) · M-790 (64.7/100) · M-620 (62.4/100). 13 MEDIUM RISK. 4 LOW RISK. M-720 has most breakdowns (852) — act now.
analytics.risk_mlnote: Score = normalize(breakdowns)×45% + normalize(cost)×35% + normalize(erraticity)×20%. Score ≥60 = HIGH. 30–60 = MEDIUM. <30 = LOW.
analytics.ml_zscore: Z-Score: measures how far each WO cost is from average (1,477 DT). Threshold = 97th percentile = 8,132 DT. BT 99549 has Z=29.7σ — nearly 30 standard deviations above normal.
analytics.ml_holtwinters: Holt-Winters: learns Level + Trend + Seasonality from 5 years. Wavy forecast follows quarterly patterns per machine.
analytics.ml_linreg: Linear Regression: fits a straight trend line per machine (2020–2025) and extends it to 2026. Slope = DT change per quarter.
analytics.footer: Maklada Eljem PFE Project · ML: Z-Score Anomaly Detection · Holt-Winters Forecast · Linear Regression · Weighted Scoring Model · Data: Dynamics AX 2012 (2020–2025)
